FlowerPainter.Recipe.AnimalPark.Descript: A visitor attraction of fenced enclosures: petting farm, paddocks, horse paddock with arena, deer park or aviary garden, with a walk, hub and viewpoints.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.Name: Animal park
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.Issue.NoPens: No room for enclosures: try fewer pens, another walk layout or a larger area.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.kind.Tooltip: Sets the pen ground, shelters and which animals the spawners call for.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.pens.Tooltip: How many fenced pens the space between the walks is cut into.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.shelters.Toolti: A shelter, stable or hutch at the back of each pen, away from the walk.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.walkIn.Tooltip: Petting and bird pens get an open gate on the walk side so visitors can go in.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.arena.Tooltip: A fenced sand arena with a course of jumps, cut out before the pens.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.aviaries.Toolti: Bird cages beside the walks, outside the pens.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.animals.Tooltip: Animal spawners in the pens (only where the game has suitable spawners).
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.pond.Tooltip: A pond inside the largest enclosure. Permanent terrain change.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.layout.Tooltip: Loop: a walk round the inside of the edge with pens in the middle. Spine: a central walk with pens either side. Trail: winding paths with pens between them.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.hub.Tooltip: A yard by the entrance with a barn, kiosk and picnic tables; features such as the playground go in its middle.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.viewpoints.Tool: Bench pairs on the walk facing the largest pens (a lookout in a deer park).
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.benchSpacing.To: Benches beside the walks every so many metres; 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.shadeTrees.Tool: Trees per hectare, inside the pens and round the walks.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.woodland.Toolti: Wooded pasture inside the pens: share of the ground under trees.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.hedgerow.Toolti: A hedge just inside the outline, with gaps at the entrances.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.wornGround.Tool: Paints trampled earth inside each pen gate. Permanent.
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.groundLayer.Too: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint (depends on the map).
FlowerPainter.AnimalPark.terrain.Tooltip: Gentle mounds (goat hills, deer park) or a level site; blended back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
